title: Dysbiosis signatures of gut microbiota and the progression of type 2 diabetes: a machine learning approach in a Mexican cohort
summary: In a cohort of 410 treatment-naïve Mexican participants, random-forest microbiome models classified T2D and prediabetes versus normoglycemia and identified candidate taxa associated with each group. This is cross-sectional association, not causal evidence of disease progression or a validated diagnostic. Cohort stratification and comparative model performance reported; cross-sectional cohort and association-only interpretation retained.
